scope: Repair post-proposal recovery so acceptance tests are phase-independent and historical Evidence Maps and Review Results remain validated but isolated from the active Work Order.
required_outputs: Active Work Order Evidence Map and Review Result isolation
Fresh exact-head Reviewer and Verifier PASS
Fresh Evidence Map and post-build critique
Replacement checkpoint proposal without rewriting H0-0-WO-001
stop_conditions: Any runtime or canonical contract path would need to change
Historical H0-0-WO-001 events would need mutation
A blocking Human Attention decision is required
risk_reasons: The repair changes which Evidence Maps and Review Results may authorize an active checkpoint.
Incorrect multi-Work-Order isolation could use stale historical PASS evidence.
The public recovery contract must remain valid after a terminal proposal and a follow-up Work Order.

design_brief.problem_statement: After H0-0-WO-001 reached CHECKPOINT_PROPOSED, a live acceptance test remained hardcoded to the preceding STALE review phase; opening a recovery Work Order also exposes global Evidence Map and Review Result identity checks across historical Work Orders.
design_brief.current_behavior: The suite passes only before fresh review/evidence is recorded, and a second Work Order rejects valid historical Evidence Maps first and historical Review Results next as identity mismatches against the new active Work Order.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Acceptance tests derive freshness expectations from independent Git/document facts. State reconstruction structurally validates every claimed Evidence Map and Review Result, then partitions each collection by work_order_id so only active documents enter active output, freshness and checkpoint authorization.
alternatives_considered: Delete or relocate historical Evidence Maps.
Create H0-0-WO-002 and implement active Work Order map/review isolation with phase-independent tests.
design_brief.selected_design: Preserve all H0-0-WO-001 commits/events, create a new bounded Work Order, validate every claimed Evidence Map and Review Result before filtering, partition each validated collection by active work_order_id, expose only active documents in review.evidence_maps and review.reviews, and make tests branch-phase independent.
design_brief.why_selected: This keeps events immutable, retains historical documents durably and validates them globally, excludes them from active output/authorization, prevents cross-Work-Order PASS reuse, and makes clean-checkout recovery valid at every checkpoint phase.
expected_risks: Historical map or review authorizing the active Work Order
Empty active evidence/review sets hidden by prior documents
Malformed historical claims skipped by filtering
Tests coupled to a particular ledger phase
validation_plan: Validate every document claiming the canonical Evidence Map or Review Result identity before filtering.
Prove historical maps and reviews remain durable and globally validated but are absent from active review.evidence_maps/review.reviews.
Prove valid historical PASS maps/reviews do not break reconstruction and cannot authorize the active Work Order.
Prove malformed claimed historical maps/reviews fail closed before partitioning.
Prove an active Work Order without its own map/review returns Status, Plan and Resume exit zero with explicit checkpoint blockers.
Prove wrong checkpoint/risk identity on the active Work Order map fails closed.
Prove fresh active map/review alone controls freshness and checkpoint authorization.
Prove H0-0-WO-001 still reduces to CHECKPOINT_PROPOSED while H0-0-WO-002 is active and emits any replacement proposal through its own ledger.
Run phase-independent tests both before and after fresh active review/evidence records are appended, deriving expectations from independent Git/document facts.
Run root/non-root Status, Plan and Resume from a clean canonical URL clone.
Verify C22 remains blocked, runtime remains unauthorized and PC0 remains non-RED.

notes: This Work Order supersedes only the unaccepted checkpoint proposal for delivery purposes; H0-0-WO-001 remains immutable historical evidence.
